recognition_features: Chestnut-brown crown with a dark central stripe.
Cream-yellow eyebrow above a bold dark eye stripe.
Pale cream throat, chest and flanks; red central lower belly and vent.
Green back and shoulder feathers; cobalt-blue rump and short tail tips.
Very short dark tail; compact ground-bird body and relatively long sturdy legs.
